KogMaw|adc.identity: Scaling marksman with physical and magic damage. Caustic Spittle (Q) deals magic damage and lowers the target's armor and magic resist (and passively increases his attack speed). Bio-Arcane Barrage (W) increases his attack range and adds magic damage based on the target's max health to his attacks. Void Ooze (E) leaves a slowing trail, and Living Artillery (R) bombards an area at very long range (more damage to low-health targets, but a mana cost that rises if you chain it). When he dies, he explodes for true damage after 4 seconds (passive).
KogMaw|adc.playstyle: Immobile hypercarry: with W up, he destroys tanks and carries from long range, but he has no mobility. He needs a support who protects him.
KogMaw|adc.early_game: Farm and survive: your strength comes with items. Turn on Bio-Arcane Barrage (W) for trades when your opponent walks up to the wave. Keep Void Ooze (E) to slow an engage.
KogMaw|adc.level_1: Bio-Arcane Barrage (W) first. Trade with W on.
KogMaw|adc.level_2: Caustic Spittle (Q). Lowers the target's resistances: Q before the trade so your attacks hurt more.
KogMaw|adc.level_3: Void Ooze (E). A line slow to escape or chase.
KogMaw|adc.level_6: Living Artillery: very long-range poke and finishing low-health targets. Don't chain it too much: its mana cost goes up.
power_spikes: First completed item: very punishing W.
Two completed items: you shred tanks.
Late game: one of the best teamfight threats.
KogMaw|adc.lane_plan: Farm and play around your support. Poke with R when you have mana. Prefer a protective support (shields, heals, disengage). The ADC role quest (300 gold, more gold per kill and per minion, then an extra item slot) is ideal for a hypercarry: one more completed item. Join dragons with W.
KogMaw|adc.trading: Basic trade: Q, then attacks with W on. All-in: E to slow, Q, attacks, R to finish. Back off as soon as W ends: without it, you're weak.
threats: Assassins and divers: you have no mobility.
Engage supports when E is down.
Nilah, Ziggs and Seraphine: hard matchups.
mistakes: Chaining your ultimate and draining your mana.
Standing in front of your frontline.

matchup_notes.Jinx: She scales too: don't take long fights without your support.
matchup_notes.Kai'Sa: She dives with her ultimate: save E to slow her when she lands.
matchup_notes.Jhin: His long-range CC is dangerous: stay behind your support.
matchup_notes.Ezreal: He pokes from afar: farm carefully, you dominate him once you have items.
matchup_notes.Varus: Save E for his Chain of Corruption.

KogMaw|adc.mid_game: Group with your team, poke with R before objectives. Stay behind your frontline with W on.
KogMaw|adc.late_game: Hit the closest target with W on: your max-health damage shreds tanks too. Your team has to protect you; you have to stay at max range.
KogMaw|adc.ahead: Force teamfights around objectives: you destroy everything in front of you.
KogMaw|adc.behind: Farm, stay with your team and wait for your items: you scale very well.
KogMaw|adc.win_condition: To win this game, you want to reach the late game and hit nonstop in teamfights, protected by your team.
KogMaw|adc.final_tip: Your W lasts a few seconds: turn it on right before you attack, not while walking to the fight.
